question: Which mantras must be used to establish the liṅga and related objects?
premises: The liṅga and related objects must be established
The previously mentioned mantras are the proper means
Other mantras enjoined by the Veda and others are excluded
inference: The liṅga and related objects must be established by those mantras, not by others enjoined by the Veda and so forth.
plain_english: By those mantras the liṅga and other things must be established, not by others enjoined by the Veda and so on.
